issue.body:
When I checked the official demo recently, I found that this code can't start the route and the parameter is missing
`import uvicorn
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import Response, PlainTextResponse
from starlette.routing import Route

async def apps(scope, receive, send):
    assert scope['type'] == 'http'
    request = Request(scope, receive)
    content = '%s %s' % (request.method, request.url.path)
    response = Response(content, media_type='text/plain')
    await response(scope, receive, send)


def text(request):
    return PlainTextResponse('Hello')

routes = [
    Route("/s/{s}", endpoint=apps),
    Route("/t/{t}", endpoint=text),
]

app = Starlette(routes=routes)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=8082)  
`
error code
`ERROR:    Exception in ASGI application
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\uvicorn\protocols\http\h11_impl.py", line 366, in run_asgi
    result = await app(self.scope, self.receive, self.send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\uvicorn\middleware\proxy_headers.py", line 75, in __call__
    return await self.app(scope, receive, send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\applications.py", line 124, in __call__
    await self.middleware_stack(scope, receive, send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\middleware\errors.py", line 184, in __call__
    raise exc
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\middleware\errors.py", line 162, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, _send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\exceptions.py", line 93, in __call__
    raise exc
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\exceptions.py", line 82, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, sender)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\routing.py", line 670, in __call__
    await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\routing.py", line 266, in handle
    await self.app(scope, receive, send)
  File "C:\Users\Yi\PycharmProjects\AppText\venv\lib\site-packages\starlette\routing.py", line 65, in app
    response = await func(request)
TypeError: apps() missing 2 required positional arguments: 'receive' and 'send'
`
The routing service doesn't seem to inherit receive and send, and can't go down
issue.title: Routes cannot use the exact parameters
